data.gender_notes: Jotin is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jotin is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Jot’ which means ‘light’ or ‘lord’. In Hindu mythology, Jotin is considered the lord of the universe and the creator of all beings. This powerful name is believed to bestow wisdom, courage, and the ability to overcome obstacles. The name Jotin carries the meaning “Lord of the universe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jotin usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jotin total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

It is believed that taking a dip in the sacred waters of the Jotisarovar, located within the forest, can cleanse one's sins and grant moksha, or liberation from the cycle of birth and death.
